$comment: Hand-maintained corrections layered over the Blogspot import, keyed by slug.
Any field of the builds schema may appear here; it wins over the parsed value.
This file exists because the post title cannot carry everything the archive
renders. Third-party makers do not use Bandai grade names, several kits are
non-scale, and the blog has no notion of a build being in progress.
Leaving a field out is fine. grade, scale and series are all optional and the
pages drop the separator rather than render an empty slot, so a grade is set
here only where the maker actually has a product line — inventing one to fill
the kicker would be worse than showing the scale alone. Run
`npm run blog:check` to list what is still unset.
